title: Online Poker in Canada Sees Steady Growth – Here’s Why
excerpt: Online poker is quietly growing in Canada, powered by regulated rooms and a healthy tournament scene.
author: Jane Williams
bodyHtml:
You may have noticed the rising popularity of online poker in Canada. Over recent years it has built a steady, loyal following rather than a boom-and-bust cycle.

Regulated rooms in Ontario, softer cash games and a busy tournament calendar are all helping poker win back players who had drifted toward casino and sports products.
